content: Maya asked about food-grade liner bags (FD-FG-30). Needs EU 10/2011 compliance documents with every shipment. Estimated usage is 40,000 bags per month.
Sent quote Q-2026-0141 for 120,000 FD-FG-30 liners (one quarter of usage). List total $10,800, 3% volume discount applied, final $10,476. Quote valid for 14 days.
Maya accepted the quote and wants delivery split into three monthly drops. She asked for Net 45 payment terms; we only offer Net 30, so this was escalated to the sales manager.
Daniel uses roughly 200 pallets per month and wants plastic pallets for a cold-storage facility. Asked about PL-PL-1210.
Sent the PL-PL-1210 spec sheet. Daniel is worried about load capacity on his racking and asked for dynamic and static load figures.
Trial order approved: 40 PL-PL-1210 plastic pallets at $27.00 each (list $1,080). Order is under $2,000 so the $120 delivery fee applies. Daniel will decide on a full switch after the trial.
Priya asked for custom-printed boxes with a dedicated lot-number area. Explained MOQ of 3,000, lead time of 21 days and a $250 setup fee per design.
Priya is concerned about humidity in her warehouse affecting box strength. Told her strength can drop significantly at sustained high humidity and recommended the 5-ply CB-RSC-5 for safety margin.
Tom complained that a bubble wrap order promised in 5 days took 11 days to arrive. He is considering other suppliers.
Apologised to Tom and offered a 5% credit note on the late order. He said he would think about it.
Tom says a competitor quoted 8% less for CB-RSC-3 corrugated boxes and asked whether we can price match. Needs a reply this week.
Aisha wants SF-500-23 stretch film for wrapping produce crates: 144 rolls per month, which is 4 pallets of film.
Aisha asked if the stretch film is UV stable because some pallets sit outdoors for weeks. Need to check the spec sheet and answer.
Met Lars at a trade show. He needs 2,000 heavy-duty boxes (600x400x400 mm) for flat-pack furniture and asked for a sample. Interested in CB-RSC-5.
Sofia needs 500 EUR-size wooden pallets for EU exports plus PET strapping. Pallets must be ISPM-15 certified. Quoted PL-EU-HT at $14.50 each.
Sofia accepted the 2/10 net 30 payment terms. Order for 500 PL-EU-HT pallets confirmed, list $7,250 with 3% volume discount.
Kenji said Pinecrest is moving to a supplier offering ESD shielding bags at a lower minimum order. Our MOQ for AS-ESD-1 is 5,000 units. Account marked churned.
